_note: KSP1PartMod animation settings. enabled: master switch for KSP1 animations. fix_mu_reader: patch Redux's .mu reader so models of format version 0 to 2 load (false leaves Redux untouched). own_first_deployable: remove Redux's deployable module from the part and let KSP1PartMod play that clip too. follow_redux_deployables: Redux keeps the state of a part's single deployable (and of parachutes) but its Mecanim copy of the clip does not move; KSP1PartMod draws the clip from Redux's state (false leaves those clips still). hide_material_less_renderers: hide the renderers of KSP1 parts whose materials are all missing (drawn with Unity's error colour). fix_part_icons: light KSP1 part icons: give the icon subject the rendering layers of the icon studio's lights (false keeps Redux's black icons). editor_animation_speed: speed of KSP1 animations in the VAB, times the flight speed: 1 = real speed (default, smooth), 1000 = instant, 0 = KSP1's own editor values (x10 for doors and panels, gear and legs instant). shader_property_map: KSP1 material property -> KSP2 property names to try, in order; when present it replaces the built-in map. subcategory_bar: in the VAB, a second vertical bar of KSP1 part types (Pods, Engines, Robotics...) next to the category bar when a KSP1 mod category is selected (false removes it). diagnostics: log once, in the VAB, the materials of a few KSP1 parts (lines '[KSP1PartMod] diag:'), for bug reports. material_curves: play the material colour and value curves of KSP1 clips (engine glow, lights, windows); false keeps them still, as before. light_curves: play the light curves of KSP1 clips (intensity, colour, range, spot angle) on lights that Redux does not drive. emission_setup: when a KSP1 glow is written to a KSP2 material whose emission is switched off, give that renderer its own material copy with emission on, and a white emission map when it has none (false leaves the materials as they are). throttle_effects: let FXModuleThrottleEffects drive the colour changers of its engine with the throttle (BDB engine glow). heat_glow: play KSP1's heat glow (Heat entries and their curves); set false if KSP2 already makes hot parts glow. skip_modules: list of KSP1 module names KSP1PartMod never takes, for example ["FXModuleThrottleEffects"], to switch one module off if it misbehaves. plugin_modules: animate the KSP1 plugin modules that Redux leaves still: engine nozzle extensions (DeployableEngines, Bluedog_DB), the multi-mode nozzle, look-at pistons, animated decouplers, RCS glow, mesh hiders, DMagic science booms (the clip only; the experiment itself is ksp1_science), the acceleration spring and the Mercury landing bag (false leaves them still, as in 0.4.0; skip_modules also names them). b9_module_gates: a B9PartSwitch subtype that switches a module off (moduleActive = false) also switches off the animation entries of that module, whatever their kind, following the variant chosen on the part; the gates apply to all our entries, phase 1 kinds included (false animates every module whatever the variant). perf_counter: log every 60 s the time spent by KSP1PartMod's animations (lines '[KSP1PartMod] anim: perf:'), and every perf_window_seconds the cost per frame of each feature (clips, 2a material, 2b plugins, shrouds, B9 gates, bridges, science, flush, look-at, radiator and drill patches, sub-category bar; lines '[KSP1PartMod] perf: frame:'), for bug reports about performance (default false: one switch read per site, nothing else). fix_fairing_init: let Redux finish setting up the jettison shroud (Module_Fairing) of KSP1 engines, which otherwise breaks them in the VAB (red cylinder left, part that cannot be picked again): an empty list of base colliders instead of a missing one, and no shroud colour set on parts without colours (false leaves Redux as it is). engine_tooltip_stats: show the max thrust, Isp and propellant of KSP1 engines in the VAB tooltip, as for KSP2 engines (false leaves the tooltip as Redux makes it). subcategory_bar_keeps_grid: while the sub-category bar is shown, widen the parts panel by the bar's width so the third column of parts is not cut (false narrows the grid instead, as in 0.4.0). share_ksp1_textures: load each KSP1 texture file once and share it between every KSP1 part that uses it, instead of one copy per part each time Redux rebuilds a part (less video memory: an estimate from reading Redux's code, not measured yet; the 'textures:' lines below give the real figures; false keeps one copy per part, as in 0.4.0). ksp1_textures_follow_quality: let the KSP1 textures that Redux keeps readable follow the game's Texture Quality setting (most KSP1 textures are not readable: Unity cannot lower them once loaded, they stay at full size either way). raise_streaming_budget: off by default; raise the game's texture streaming budget by the memory the KSP1 textures take, so KSP2 textures keep their resolution, capped at the video card's memory less a quarter (at least 1 GB); can cause stutter on cards with little memory. Lines '[KSP1PartMod] textures:' in the log give the texture memory at the end of the import and at each VAB or flight entry. ksp1_engine_shrouds: keep the KSP1 mesh of engine shrouds (ModuleJettison) and show it the way KSP1 does, instead of Redux's Module_Fairing, which cannot size or colour it: the shroud shows while a part is attached below the engine (in the VAB and in flight), follows the chosen part variant, and goes away on decoupling (or on staging for an engine that is not a fairing); it has no mass, drag or debris; it acts only when enabled is true (false gives the behaviour of 0.6.0, Redux's Module_Fairing included). audit_on_vab_entry: off by default; when true, the first time you enter the VAB in a game session KSP1PartMod loads every KSP1 part once, off screen and one at a time, and writes a report (audit-<date>.csv and .md in the mod folder audit/) of the parts that fail, throw, stay unfinished or log errors; it changes nothing in your craft (a part that crashes the game is skipped at the next run). audit_frame_budget_ms: time the audit may use per frame, in milliseconds (default 8, 1 to 50). audit_unload_every: number of parts between two unloads of the audit's textures (default 100, 10 to 1000). ModuleManager patches (applied by Redux when it imports KSP1 parts; nothing is written to the cfg files): mm_plugin_safety_net: KSP1 plugins (DLLs) never run under Redux, so a plugin's folder proves nothing: the names below are treated as absent, :NEEDS[name] is false and :NEEDS[!name] is true, and the patches written for them (:FOR[name], :BEFORE[name], :AFTER[name], and the patches inside that folder) are left out; parts are never removed (false: Redux's rule, a folder of that name counts as present). mm_plugin_folders: the plugin names always treated as absent (RealFuels, FAR, Kerbalism, TweakScale...); add or remove a name here. mm_plugin_folders_auto: also treat as absent every KSP1 folder that holds a .dll and no part. mm_needs_keep: names never treated as absent, even with a .dll (B9PartSwitch, Waterfall and the libraries whose behaviour Redux or KSP1PartMod reproduces). mm_before_after_need_mod: as ModuleManager does, leave out a patch whose :BEFORE[name] or :AFTER[name] names a mod that is not there (a :FOR name counts as there; :LAST patches are always kept). mm_arithmetic: apply ModuleManager's *=, +=, -= and /= on values (Redux skips them; ^= and != stay skipped); a value that is not a single number is left as is. mm_index_selectors: apply ModuleManager's ,n ,-n and ,* after a value or node name (@volume,1 edits the second volume only; Redux edits them all). mm_edit_first_match: off by default; when true, an edit without an index changes the first match only, as ModuleManager does (false: every match, as Redux does). Lines '[KSP1PartMod] mm:' in the log count what each of these changes. Native modules (KSP1 modules that Redux drops, imported as KSP2's own module; applied by Redux's import whatever enabled is): ksp1_crossfeed_toggle: KSP1's ModuleToggleCrossfeed (decouplers and adapters) becomes KSP2's crossfeed toggle: the switch in the VAB and in flight and the three action-group actions, starting in the cfg's crossfeedStatus; its techRequired is ignored, the toggle is there from the start (false: Redux drops the module, as in 0.7.0). ksp1_heatshields: KSP1's ModuleAblator (heat shields, capsules) becomes KSP2's heat shield (Module_Heatshield): it burns the part's Ablator above the cfg's ablationTempThresh and shields the part when its bottom faces the airflow; its burn rate is KSP2's own heat shield rate (scaled by the cfg's pyrolysisLossFactor), the same for every size, so that each square metre of shield lasts about as long as KSP2's in the same reentry; KSP1's temperature curve (lossExp, lossConst) and reentryConductivity are not reproduced; a part without the resource gets no heat shield (false: Redux drops the module, as in 0.7.0). ablator_rate_scale: multiplies that rate (default 1, 0.01 to 100): above 1 the shields burn faster, below 1 slower. ablator_char: the shield's char colour (shieldChar) follows the part's own Ablator, from clean (full) to black (empty); needs ksp1_heatshields and enabled (false: the colour stays as in 0.7.0). Lines '[KSP1PartMod] native:' in the log say what was converted. B9PartSwitch overrides (0.9.0; applied by Redux's variant builder, whatever enabled is; a line '[KSP1PartMod] b9: armed:' lists what is on): b9_mass: a B9 subtype's mass (addedMass plus tankMass times the tank volume, as a part-switch mass modifier) changes the part's mass with the subtype in the VAB and in flight (false: Redux's masses). b9_resources: a tank subtype's resources and capacities replace the base ones (false: Redux's resources); a part with a second tank switch keeps Redux's resources. b9_module_data: a subtype's MODULE DATA edits (engine thrust and Isp, gimbal, RCS, solar panel, command) are applied to the matching KSP2 module through V-SwiFT (false: not applied). b9_module_active: a subtype that turns a gimbal, an RCS or a decoupler off uses the native off form; engines and other modules stay on; needs b9_module_data (false: not applied). b9_part_scalars: a subtype's maxTemp, skinMaxTemp, crashTolerance and CoMOffset are applied, in flight only (the VAB shows the base values) (false: not applied). b9_new_part_switches: a part that had no part switch in 0.8.0 but whose B9 subtypes change something gets one, with readable names; false leaves such parts without a menu, as in 0.8.0. Setting a b9_ key to false acts on new crafts, and on a vessel already in flight only from its next save: its saved overrides apply until then, and its saved mass delta stays until the craft is rebuilt in the VAB. Converters, drills and scanners (0.10.0; at the import, whatever enabled is; lines '[KSP1PartMod] native:' and '[KSP1PartMod] isru:' in the log): ksp1_converters: the KSP1 resource converters of a part (fuel cells, ISRU units, generators) become one KSP2 resource converter (Module_ResourceConverter) with one mode per KSP1 converter, chosen in its Mode menu; one mode runs at a time, at full rate, with KSP2's rules (it stops when an output is full, KSP1's DumpExcess, FillAmount, crew bonus and core temperature are not reproduced); a mode that uses a resource the game does not have is dropped (false: Redux drops the converters, as in 0.9.0). ksp1_drills: a KSP1 ground drill (ModuleResourceHarvester of HarvesterType 0) becomes Redux's drill (Module_Mine): deployed with the KSP1PartMod button and touching the ground, it mines in proportion to Redux's resource map where the vessel stands; ocean, atmospheric, exospheric, asteroid and comet harvesting do not exist in KSP2 and are skipped (false: Redux drops the drills, as in 0.9.0). ksp1_survey_scanners: KSP1's orbital survey scanner (ModuleOrbitalSurveyor) becomes Redux's resource scanner (Module_ResourceScanner), with the KSP2 scanner's resources, power and polar-orbit window, and KSP1's scan time; a finished scan shows the body's resource maps (false: not converted). ksp1_resource_scanners: a KSP1 ModuleResourceScanner that reads abundance without a survey (RequiresUnlock false, such as the surface scanner) becomes Redux's resource scanner for its resource, below its maximum altitude; KSP2 records that scan for the whole body; scanners that need a survey first (RequiresUnlock true) have no KSP2 counterpart and are left out (false: not converted). ksp1_ore_resource: the KSP2 resource KSP1's Ore becomes in tanks, converters and drills (default CarbonRegolith, the regolith KSP2's own ISRU turns into Methane and Oxidizer); "" or "TestRocks" keeps Redux's mapping (TestRocks, which no body has a map of, so KSP1 drills then mine nothing and are skipped); a name the game does not know keeps TestRocks; the remap applies to every campaign of the game session, the mod enabled or not, and the TestRocks of a vessel saved in 0.9.0 is moved to it on load, mass kept (VAB workspaces are not migrated); there is no way back: setting it to "TestRocks" again after playing with the remap empties the KSP1 Ore tanks of saved vessels. harvest_multiplier: multiplies the yield of KSP1 drills (default 1, 0.01 to 100); a KSP1 drill mines what KSP2's own drill mines per unit of electric charge, times the KSP1 drill's own electric charge use, times its KSP1 Efficiency against that of the stock KSP1 drills (0.1 per unit of electric charge), times this multiplier and the local resource-map value; with 1 the stock KSP1 drills yield what KSP2's drill yields for the same power; raise it if drills are too slow, lower it if too fast. isru_heat_scale: multiplies the heat that converters and drills put into their part (default 1, 0 to 10; 0: no heat); the heat is KSP2's own heat per unit of electric charge, and KSP2's thermal shutdown stops the part at 90 % of its maximum temperature. isru_active_animation: the 'running' clip of a KSP1 ModuleAnimationGroup (ISRU, drills) plays while the part's KSP2 converter, drill or scanner runs; needs enabled (false: the clip plays only for parts that KSP1 marks as always active, as in 0.9.0). isru_ksp1_rates: off by default: each mode of a KSP1 converter that uses electric charge (ISRU units) is scaled by one factor so that it consumes, per unit of electric charge, what KSP2's own converter consumes (its power use, its heat and its ratios between inputs and outputs stay KSP1's), so that one KSP1 drill feeds a KSP1 ISRU at a KSP2 pace, as KSP2's drill feeds KSP2's converter; the factor of each mode is in the log; true keeps KSP1's rates (a KSP1 ISRU then eats about 600 times what a KSP1 drill mines, and stops itself as soon as its Ore tank is empty); converters without an electric charge input (fuel cells) always keep KSP1's rates. Radiators (0.11.0; at the import, whatever enabled is; lines '[KSP1PartMod] native:' and '[KSP1PartMod] thermal:' in the log): ksp1_radiators: a KSP1 ModuleActiveRadiator becomes KSP2's cooler (Module_Cooler), or Module_ActiveRadiator when the part also has a ModuleDeployableRadiator; it removes heat from every hot part of its vessel through KSP2's own thermal model (maxEnergyTransfer / 50 kW, so a large folding radiator removes 1000 kW); parentCoolingOnly, overcoolFactor, isCoreRadiator (no core heat in KSP2) and load-proportional electric use are not reproduced, nor are the panel tracking, wind and break fields (false: Redux drops the module, as in 0.10.0). radiator_deploy_bridge: a deployable KSP1 radiator cools only while its KSP1 deploy clip is extended and switches off when folded; needs enabled to follow the clip (false: it cools folded too). radiator_auto_on: fixed radiators start on and deployable ones turn on when they are extended (false: all start off until you switch them on, as KSP2's own radiators). radiator_flux_scale: multiplies the kW a KSP1 radiator removes (default 1, 0.01 to 100); raise it if radiators are too weak, lower it if too strong. radiator_ksp1_rates: off by default: a radiator uses KSP2's electric charge rate per kW (100 kW per EC/s in 26w42c, so a large folding radiator draws 10 EC/s whenever it is on); true keeps the cfg rate of KSP1 (0.5 EC/s for the same radiator); other resources (XenonGas) always keep their cfg rate. ksp1_science: KSP1 experiment modules (ModuleScienceExperiment, DMModuleScienceAnimate, DMModuleScienceAnimateGeneric) become KSP2's science module (Module_ScienceExperiment), one experiment per KSP1 experiment, run from the part menu, the action group or the HUD science button; labs, converters, part tests, ground science, the kerbal experiments, reset and diminishing returns are not reproduced (false: Redux drops the modules, as in 0.11.0, and no definition is generated). science_generate_definitions: a KSP1 EXPERIMENT_DEFINITION found under mods/KSP1 becomes a KSP2 experiment KSP1_<id> with its title, situations, value and flavor texts; biomes become KSP2's regions of the vessel (false: every KSP1 experiment uses the identical or closest KSP2 experiment). science_definitions_via_patch_manager: the generated experiments are added through Redux's Patch Manager, so a campaign where KSP1PartMod is off has none (false: they are added to the game's experiment store when KSP1PartMod is on in the campaign). science_report_storage: a KSP1 part with a ModuleScienceContainer or an experiment stores research reports, as KSP2's command parts do; Redux sets this on no KSP1 part (false: only KSP2 parts store, as in 0.11.0). science_value_scale: multiplies KSP1's baseValue into the KSP2 data and sample values (default 1, 0.01 to 100); raise it if KSP1 experiments give too little science, lower it if too much. science_transmit_split: a KSP1 experiment that transmits only part of its value (xmitDataScalar below 1) gives a data report worth that part, to transmit, and a sample worth the rest, to recover (false: one data report at full value). science_native_ids: KSP1 experiment ids that use an identical KSP2 experiment instead of a generated one (default crewReport -> CrewObservation); an object here replaces the whole table. science_fallback_ids: the KSP2 experiment of a KSP1 experiment with no definition on disk (the stock instruments when the stock ScienceDefs.cfg is not under mods/KSP1); an object here replaces the whole table; two KSP1 instruments that share a KSP2 experiment score once per location together. science_skip_ids: KSP1 experiment ids that get no experiment (default the kerbal experiments evaReport, evaScience and surfaceSample, which KSP2 kerbals replace with their own, and ROCScience). science_deploy_animations: running an experiment opens the KSP1 clip KSP1 played (the FxModules of a stock instrument, the DMagic toggle of a BDB instrument); the clip stays open and closes with its button; needs enabled. science_wait_for_animation: a DMagic experiment with experimentWaitForAnimation completes once its clip is open, through KSP2's own deploy gate; needs enabled (false: it completes at once and the clip plays alongside). perf_load_timeline: times Redux's KSP1 import phases, KSP1PartMod's importers and load steps, and logs '[KSP1PartMod] perf: import:' and 'perf: ours:' lines; it only measures (false: no timing patch, as 0.12.0). perf_memory_lines: logs process memory and a census of the live KSP1 textures at each memory moment and at the main menu (lines 'perf: memory at' and 'textures: census at'; false: the 0.12.0 'textures: memory/cache' lines only). perf_report_file: writes <mod>/perf/perf-<date>.md, the file to send with Player.log, rewritten at each memory moment; the 10 newest are kept (false: no file). perf_top_n: length of the slowest-parts and largest-textures lists (1 to 50). perf_window_seconds: window of the per-feature frame lines 'perf: frame:' that perf_counter adds (2 to 300; the 'anim: perf:' line keeps 60 s). Wheels (0.14.0; at the import, whatever enabled is; lines '[KSP1PartMod] native:' and '[KSP1PartMod] wheel:' in the log; KSP2's own wheel modules do all the physics): ksp1_wheels: KSP1's ModuleWheelBase and ModuleWheelSuspension become KSP2's Module_WheelBase and Module_WheelSuspension, one wheel per part, so KSP1 wheels, gear and landing legs roll and spring; a folding gear is switched on and off by Redux's own deployable, and in flight G toggles it once (KSP2's wheel adds its own Gear action, so the KSP1PartMod gear button stands down there and the VAB lists no Gear action for it); a wheel whose deployable Redux kept as its legacy Ksp1Module_Deployable keeps the KSP1PartMod button but rolls while folded (line '[KSP1PartMod] wheel:' names it) (false: Redux drops every wheel module, as in 0.13.1, and the wheel_ keys below do nothing). wheel_steering: ModuleWheelSteering becomes Module_WheelSteering, with KSP1's steering curves (steeringRange is taken from the curve, as KSP2 does). wheel_motors: ModuleWheelMotor and ModuleWheelMotorSteering become Module_WheelMotor and Module_WheelMotorSteering, with KSP1's torque curve and KSP1's electric charge rate. wheel_brakes: ModuleWheelBrakes becomes Module_WheelBrakes, with KSP1's brake torque, read as kN·m (KSP2 limits it to the tyre's grip). wheel_leg_locks: ModuleWheelLock becomes Module_WheelLock, the resting grip that keeps landing legs from sliding. wheel_damage: ModuleWheelDamage becomes Module_WheelDamage, so a wheel can break and be repaired by a kerbal (false: KSP1 wheels never break). wheel_bogeys: ModuleWheelBogey becomes Module_WheelBogey, so feet and bogies pitch with the ground. wheel_ksp1_friction: KSP1's frictionPeak and frictionLimit, and manual friction where KSP1 had no auto friction (landing legs) (false: KSP2's 1.45 and 1.1 and auto friction). wheel_ksp1_deploy_timing: the TsubSys and useStandInCollider of KSP1's ModuleWheelDeployment: the point of the deploy clip where the wheel switches on, and the sphere a folded gear rests on (false: KSP2's timing, 0.98 and 0.02, and no stand-in collider). chute_canopy_reset: before Redux turns the canopy of a KSP1 parachute towards the airflow, put its canopy bone back to the parent's rotation each frame, so radial canopies no longer spread out and spin (false: 0.13.0). plume_diagnostics: log the plume objects of KSP1 engines in flight, once when the engine loads and once 3 s after it first runs, at most twice per part type (lines '[KSP1PartMod] plume:'); diagnostic only, it changes nothing. fix_engine_emissive_curve: give KSP1 engines the emissive temperature curve Redux's import leaves empty, so saved vessels with KSP1 engines are no longer skipped as corrupted when they load (false: 0.13.0). fix_intake_mach_curve: give KSP1 air intakes the mach curve Redux's import leaves empty (the cfg's own machCurve, else KSP2's flight default, full intake at every speed), so their tooltip no longer errors in the VAB and R&D (false: 0.15.0). ksp1_procedural_fairings: KSP1 ModuleProceduralFairing bases become KSP2's own procedural fairing (Module_Fairing), edited with KSP2's fairing editor and jettisoned by staging; needs fix_fairing_init (false: a bare base, as 0.14.0). ksp1_saf_fairings: BDB SimpleAdjustableFairings bases become the same KSP2 fairing and their KSP1 wall, base and cone meshes are hidden; needs fix_fairing_init and ksp1_engine_shrouds (false: as 0.14.0).

shader_property_map._note: The first name the material has is used. _EmissionColor comes first: it is the emission property seen on the KSP2 shaders of KSP1 parts in game.
